mapper.select: SELECT t2.menu_id from sys_user_role t1 INNER JOIN sys_role_menu t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id WHERE t1.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t2.menu_id
select user_id userId,avatar,nick_name nickName,user_name userName,email,phone,sex,major from sys_user where user_name = #{username} and status = 1

select distinct A.user_id userId,A.nick_name nickName,A.user_name userName FROM `sys_user` A join sys_user_role B on A.user_id = B.user_id join sys_role C on B.role_id = C.role_id where C.weight != 10 and C.role_status = 1 and A.status = 1

select distinct A.user_id userId,A.nick_name nickName,A.user_name userName FROM `sys_user` A join sys_user_role B on A.user_id = B.user_id join sys_role C on B.role_id = C.role_id where C.weight >= 5 and C.weight != 10 and C.role_status = 1 and A.status = 1
select user_id userId,avatar,nick_name nickName,user_name userName,email,phone,sex,major from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1
